## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 6 dishes (2 Ivorian-only: alloco, kedjenou); Wikipedia-style descriptions naming ingredients, no amounts.
- [[FmLAMA]]: 2 dishes (foutou banane, bawin sauce); Wikidata ingredient lists, no amounts.
- [[World Wide Dishes]]: 2 dishes shared with Ghana/Nigeria (fufu, pounded yam).

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national FCT is in the vault. The [[FAO INFOODS global databases]] candidate (priority 2, directory of 308 tables) includes the FAO/INFOODS **West African Food Composition Table (WAFCT)**, a regional table for the ECOWAS countries including Côte d'Ivoire; processing it is the most direct way to get local foods (fonio, cowpea, shea, baobab, leafy sauces). Until then, use [[USDA FoodData Central]] by name matching.
- [[CMAUP]]: 109 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 108 ethnobotany records (57 taxa), almost all Ayensu (fever, gonorrhoea, arrow poison).
- [[KNApSAcK Family]] lists Côte d'Ivoire on its World map, but African flag pages were not scraped (counts unknown).
- Compound → effect chains come from the global backbone via [[Global]] ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions).

## Gaps
- No Ivorian-only dishes in World Wide Dishes; attiéké and garba are missing.
- WAFCT not yet processed.
